items.headline: $NEAR Intents Halts After $3.8M Exploit, Promises Refunds
items.summary: The $NEAR Intents protocol paused services after a $3.8M exploit and pledged full compensation. Deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks face an extended suspension while repairs continue.

items.headline: DogeOS Testnet Brings EVM Smart Contracts to $DOGE
items.summary: DogeOS launched a public testnet for its zero-knowledge rollup bringing EVM smart contracts to Dogecoin, with $DOGE used for gas fees. A big DeFi unlock for the original memecoin.

items.headline: $WLFI Staking Goes Live With 180-Day Locks, $1.25M Pool
items.summary: World Liberty launched $WLFI staking with a planned $1.25M USD1 rewards pool. Holders must open a 180-day lock and cast governance votes to claim rewards, with no fixed payout rate.

items.headline: $DRIFT Opens DFX Claims but Recovery Pool Covers Just 1%
items.summary: The $DRIFT protocol opened DFX claims for exploit victims, but its recovery pool covers only about 1% of losses. Holders can burn DFX to redeem, wait for revenue-funded recovery, or sell.

items.headline: $MNDE: Marinade Council Blocks Attempted DAO Takeover
items.summary: Marinade says its council vetoed two proposals within six hours to block an attempted takeover of the $MNDE DAO. No funds moved, and its staking services were unaffected.
